Ending: EO 8189 of July 5, 1939 (4 FR 2783, held govinfo FR PDF text), 'Revocation of Executive Orders: The following executive orders are hereby revoked: ... EO 8189 states no effective date of its own (the 'effective July 1, 1939' sentences on the same FR page belong to EOs 8190 and 8191), so it took effect on signing, July 5, 1939 (filed July 6, 1939). The actor is EO 8189; the dossier's duplicate ACT records for EOs 8190-8192 point at the same page and were not used.

research_rationale: Original: EO 5614 of May 1, 1931 (Reporting of Expenditures for Use in the Budget), read in full in the official OFR 1974 Hoover PEO vol. II, printed p. 838 (PDF p. 67): enacting sentence under the Budget and Accounting Act, three numbered paragraphs, signature and number; the held OCR is complete. Ending: EO 8512 of August 13, 1940 (5 FR 2849, held govinfo FR PDF text), Section 9: 'Executive Orders No. 5614 of May 1, 1931, No. 6226 of July 27, 1933, No. 6869 ... and all other orders or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this order are hereby revoked.' EO 8512 states no other effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing, August 13, 1940 (filed August 14, 1940). All three paragraphs end together on that date.
savings_reason: EO 8512 contains no savings clause for actions under EO 5614; reports already furnished were completed acts with no continuing EO-traceable condition.

earlier_end_check: No earlier end found. The only related prior order held, EO 6226 of July 27, 1933 (encumbrance/apportionment reports; held APP text), governs a different subject (obligations and apportionments) and does not amend or revoke EO 5614; EO 8512 revoking both in the same list confirms EO 5614 was still extant in 1940. independent_command_check: Paragraph 3 (Treasury forms) is a dependent implementing authority that falls with the order; no paragraph is an independent command surviving the revocation. EO 8512 replaces the subject with its own regulations, which are EO 8512's commands, not continuations of EO 5614.
